svg.title: R15 XEM8305/LDO carrier · actual native six-layer routing
svg.desc: Native top-view copper geometry in millimetres. Six independently selectable copper layers, saved plane fills, pads and plated vias. Back copper is not mirrored. Hover copper for net names. No component models or private paths are embedded.
